children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Triage the fleet from compact cards and navigation while recognizing when a detailed task requires desktop.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Use desktop for dense forms, raw logs, credentials, confirmations, restores, and irreversible actions.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Mobile cards summarize server identity, endpoint, game, state, players, and memory for quick triage.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Search by name and confirm endpoint and game.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Distinguish Running, Starting, and CrashLoop responses.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Open desktop Events or logs for degraded state.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Confirm instance, cluster, destination, signed-in user, and role before following a link or action.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Navigate Dashboard, Servers, Modules, Backups, and admin areas.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: The profile footer confirms identity and role.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Close the drawer and re-check cluster context after navigation.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Current mobile is designed for triage and navigation, not console, files, configuration, restore, or danger-zone work.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Search cards; confirm server, endpoint, game, state, players, memory

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Drawer confirms instance, destination, user, and role

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Mobile = triage; desktop = detailed, credentialed, destructive
